endpoint: strong_new_score (dry=0 -> wet CallingIndex 2-3 weighted by wet CallingIndex).

leave_one_state_out.model: Original strong_new_score matched model with State and RunNumber fixed effects, route-clustered covariance after excluding one state.
leave_one_state_out.strong_rule: Descriptive only: report whether all leave-one-state-out 95% CIs remain >0; this is not required for geographic robustness.

state_specific.eligibility: >=50 pairs and >=8 routes in a state.
state_specific.model: strong_new_score ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + RunNumber, clustered by route.
state_specific.use: Report effect-size directions and intervals only. No per-state significance gate.

interpretation.pass: Strong new chorus activation is not controlled by any single sampled state.
interpretation.boundary: This does not mean every state has the same effect or establish continental universality.
